parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json||{};const text=String(r.text||r.input?.text||'').trim();const ai=r.ai_result||r.input?.ai_result||null;const cfg=r.config||r.input?.config||{};if(!text) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C4-C',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'MISSING_TEXT',message:'text is required.'},next_action:'provide_text'}}];if(!ai){const request={task:'summarize',text,style:cfg.style||'concise',max_points:Number(cfg.max_points||5),output_schema:{summary:'string',key_points:'string[]',confidence:'number'}};return [{json:{success:true,component_id:'C4-C',component_version:'v1',stage:'llm_request_ready',llm_request:request,next_action:'execute_via_c2_k',error:null}}];}const summary=String(ai.summary||'').trim();const pts=Array.isArray(ai.key_points)?ai.key_points.map(String).filter(Boolean):[];const confidence=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(ai.confidence??0.5)));const valid=!!summary;return [{json:{success:valid,component_id:'C4-C',component_version:'v1',stage:'normalized',summary,key_points:pts,confidence,manual_review_required:!valid||confidence<Number(cfg.min_confidence??0.6),next_action:!valid?'retry_or_manual_review':confidence<Number(cfg.min_confidence??0.6)?'manual_review':'summary_ready',error:valid?null:{code:'INVALID_AI_SUMMARY',message:'AI result did not contain a summary.'}}}];
